blockingFindings.description: V83 increased the declared under-shorts hem extension to 160 mm, but measured upper-thigh coverage is unchanged from V82: sit 15.37% covered by under-shorts per thigh and crouch 26.67%; the overskirt covers only 18.53-18.64% seated and 32.77-32.88% crouched. Direct sit/crouch images show extensive exposed thighs. This extension-only method does not address posed coverage.
Sit and crouch images retain folded lavender edging, overlapping angular white panels, and visible panel/leg interference around the knees and calves.

Front/side/neutral and back views retain corrugated side panels, projecting hem corners, angular surface shading, and irregular inner-layer hem protrusion; buyer-facing drape and layering remain unresolved.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
